newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver ease on lower world prices.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver ease on lower world prices.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closes 20 rupees lower at 4,800 as profit-taking on weaker world market trims early gains.
** Prices of gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) drops 200 rupees to 56,200 per piece. They were down 100 rupees on Wednesday.
** Silver (.999) fell 30 rupees to 7,420 per kg on fresh arrivals while industrial buyers kept to the sidelines in falling market.
Gold met with demand resistance after opening 10 rupees higher at 4,830 per 10 gramme and lower world prices snuffed out buyers, dealers said.
Silver started shakily 40 rupees lower at 7,410 per kg undermined by overnight losses in world markets but perked up slightly on speculative demand, the dealers said. (Conversion $1=35.84 rupees)
